Upgrade your bathroom cabinetry with solid brass cabinet hardware designed to add a distinctive finishing touch in Brushed Bronze, features warm, earthy tones with a softly textured surface that adds depth to traditional and transitional bathrooms. This 3-inch cabinet pull brings a balanced transitional look that pairs contemporary lines with traditional elements, helping you coordinate drawers and cabinet doors with matching pieces across a cabinet hardware collection.

- Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
- Cabinet-mount installation with all mounting hardware included

- Limited Lifetime Warranty
